raw.title: Giordano Bruno
raw.description: Italian Dominican friar, philosopher and mathematician (1548–1600)
raw.extract: Giordano Bruno was an Italian philosopher, Dominican friar and priest, poet, alchemist, astronomer, cosmological theorist, and esotericist. He is known for his cosmological theories, which included the then-novel Copernican model. He practised Hermeticism and took a mystical approach to exploring the universe. He proposed that stars are distant suns surrounded by their own planets (exoplanets), and raised the possibility that these planets might foster life of their own, a cosmological position known as cosmic pluralism. He also insisted that the universe is infinite and can have no centre.
